GATE FAILED on appearance, but the mechanism works: strongest geometry gain of any single change - floaters gt0.3m 233->118 (-49%), gt1m 20->8 (-60%), depth 4.924->4.793, p10 +0.73dB. True alpha-transmittance attribution routes capacity precisely to the largest error - and under an L1 error map the largest error is geometric, so it fixes geometry at the expense of texture

KEY INSIGHT worth more than either arm: the error map, not the attribution method, decides where capacity goes. Same attribution, L1 map targets colour deficits (geometry), SSIM map targets structural deficits (texture/edges). They cannot both be had by tuning the attribution; a blend or a schedule between the two maps is the open question
